items.title: 61428_Red Callender oral history interview
items.q: I used to go back there and fish with my grandfather, who would take a bent pin and put a worm on it

ctx.x: Richmond, Virginia. Yes, that's where I was born. Not actually in Richmond; Richmond is a city. But my folks had a farm outside of Richmond, and actually it was called Haynesville, Post Office. I remember that. There was a screen through the back, which is not important to this, but anyhow I can remember it. I used to go back there and fish with my grandfather, who would take a bent pin and put a worm on it, and go back in the stream and fish -- he'd catch catfish. I remember being a little guy, I got stuck in a…
I never caught a catfish... Yes, I think I did, come to think of it.
